user.title: Add Solar Forecast
user.description: Configure your array geometry and choose an initial weather model for testing.

data.name: Name
data.azimuth: Panel azimuth (0 north, 90 east, 180 south, 270 west)

data_description.declination: Tilt in degrees. Use 0 for flat panels and 90 for vertical panels.
data_description.azimuth: Compass direction using Home Assistant format: 0 north, 90 east, 180 south, 270 west.
data_description.panel_power: Total DC array size in watt-peak, for example 4000 for a 4 kWp system.
data_description.inverter_power: Optional AC inverter limit in watts. Leave blank if you do not want clipping applied yet.
data_description.loss_percent: Estimated whole-system losses as a percentage. A starting value around 10 to 15 is often reasonable.
data_description.temperature_coefficient: Usually a small negative value such as -0.004. Output falls as panel temperature rises.
data_description.weather_model: Start with Automatic for general use, then compare UK Met Office, ECMWF, DWD, or GFS during testing to see which is most accurate for your site.
